i.e., those who refuse His guidance.
Days of blessings bestowed upon the Children of Israel.  Also interpreted as days of punishment and destruction of the former nations.
Several explanations have been given as to the meaning.  Based upon the conclusion of the verse, Ibn Katheer preferred that this was a gesture of denial and rejection.
An alternative meaning is "the standing [for account] before Me."
Literally, "after him [in time]," meaning ahead of him.
That which oozes from the skins of Hell's inhabitants.
By your obedience to me instead of Him during life on earth.
The testimony that there is no deity except Allāh and that Muḥammad (ﷺ) is the messenger of Allāh.
When questioned in their graves by the angels after death.
They met Allāh's blessing with denial instead of gratitude.
Something of what you asked and all of what you continually require, according to His wisdom.
i.e., disbelieving and denying of Allāh's favor.
This is their state at the time of resurrection from the graves.  Their heads are upraised in fixed stares of terror, unable even to glance back.
Of the blessings which Allāh had bestowed upon you during life on earth.
An alternative meaning is "...and their plan was not [sufficient] to do away with the mountains," i.e., it had no effect against Allāh's will.
